M12 · Should the page stay still when the offline bar comes or goes?

The bar takes room above the page, so when it comes or goes, everything on the page moves down or up by its height. If you tap just as the connection comes back, the tap can land on the next row's button, and that save then works. (Found by M12's design review. The amber ring and dashed line are where the finger is.)

When a bar comes or goes, should the page stay still under your finger?

A · Keep it as built
The page moves down when the bar comes and up when it goes: 48px on PC, 91px on a phone. Panel size's "not saved" bar (live since v1.118) works this way today.
+ Nothing on the page is ever out of view because of the bar.
− A tap aimed just as the connection comes back can land on the next row's button (here Ella Grant's Check in instead of Chloe Nguyen's), and that save then works.
B · Keep the page still (my pick)
When a bar comes or goes, the page's own scroll moves by the bar's height, so whatever is under your finger stays put. It works the same for both bars in that place (the offline bar and Panel size's).
+ Taps land where you aimed, at every size.
− While the bar shows at the very top of a page, the page's first line (the back link) sits just out of view; scroll up to see it. A page too short to scroll still moves.
